# API tests
curl https://api.example.com/health

# This is a comment

curl https://example.com

curl -H "X: a|b" https://b.test

curl --compressed https://a.test/1

curl --foo bar https://a.test/3

curl https://a.test/1

curl https://a.test/1
curl -X POST \
  -H 'A: b' \
  https://a.test/2

cat <<EOF
curl https://no.test
EOF

curl -d '{}' https://a.test/b
curl -d 'null' https://a.test/c
